none: PAS NLM-1521A0: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I from Winterton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diadened right. Obverse inscription: DN[--]TIN[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 15.2mm, Weight: 2.34gms, die axis: 6
